description: This file defines the LeaveDetailsActivity class, an Android activity for displaying and editing details of a leave entry, including date selection, save, and delete operations.

classes.name: LeaveDetailsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for managing leave details, including UI interactions, date picking, and data persistence via LeaveManager.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads existing leave data if available.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options for saving or deleting a leave, adjusts visibility based on context.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections such as save, delete, and navigation.

methods.name: showDatePicker
methods.description: Displays a date picker dialog for selecting a date.

methods.name: updateDateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the date EditText with the selected date in formatted form.

methods.name: loadLeave
methods.description: Loads leave data by ID and populates the UI fields.

methods.name: saveLeave
methods.description: Validates and saves the leave data, either creating or updating.

methods.name: showDeleteConfirmation
methods.description: Shows confirmation dialog before deleting leave.
